messages:
liam: Hey team — PR #8033 landed microbatch scheduler tweak. Quick smoke: longseq p99 up ~6% on 2k tokens. Full perf run attached: https://artifacts/redwood/bench/8033/2026-11-10

priya: can you paste the numbers?

liam: Sure
```
model: redwood-base-7b
input: longseq-2k
baseline p50/p95/p99: 45/120/320 ms
candidate p50/p95/p99: 44/118/340 ms
note: p99 +20 ms (~6%)
```

jamie: Hmm small but consistent?

liam: 5 runs, CI overlaps but p99 median shifted. I suspected KV eviction timing changed

jamie: Could be noise from alloc jitter. Did you run with stable loads? env: canary-3 (no other traffic)

liam: yes canary-3 isolated. Also ran with --stable-seed flag

noah: pinging @priya and @maya for approval. If we need, we can canary with background traffic to confirm.

priya: I can do one more 10-run sweep tonight and attach flame graphs. If delta persists I'd prefer hold.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-11-10T22:15Z (canary-3) — will run 1h. Reply 'confirm' to proceed.

liam: confirm

maya: I'm +1 for merge if post-sweep shows no regression vs baseline within noise. If p99 still up, rollback and reopen.

priya: started runs — attaching output when done: https://artifacts/redwood/bench/8033/runs.json

liam: thanks. will wait for results. tagging reviewers: @jamie @noah

jamie: thx

noah: FYI I'll be slower to reply after 18:00 PT

priya: results: p99 deltas are smaller after warming (~+3%) but some shards show +7%. I think it's related to shard packing change in PR. I'll add per-shard breakdown.

liam: added comments to PR with perf notes and a test that pins shard size. Also added a canary toggle to revert packing.

maya: sounds good. Let's avoid blocking release unless p99 >10% or absolute >50ms.

liam: agreed. leaving a merge hold until we see the per-shard graph. Thanks all :pray:
